content: Local-first SPA pattern: UI reads/writes local DB as source of truth (no fetch to server in v1). Repository pattern abstracts IndexedDB — domain layer defines interfaces, infrastructure implements with Dexie. Business logic (streak, completion rate, heatmap data) lives in pure functions in domain/ layer, testable without browser. UI components subscribe via useLiveQuery or thin hooks wrapping repositories. Actions flow: Component -> UseCase/Handler -> Repository -> IndexedDB -> reactive update back to UI. Export/import is a separate BackupService that serializes/deserializes full schema with version field.
